name: submit_voice
description:
Submit a final TTS generation job. This tool creates an audio asset only; it does not place or replace timeline items. Before using this tool, load/read the `voice` Skill if you have not already. The `voice` Skill contains the current TTS contract, voice audition/selection flow, reuse rules, and timeline replacement workflow. manage_voice action="list" is the live source for official and cloned voice candidates. Call this only after the user has selected or confirmed a concrete provider + voiceId, or after the `voice` Skill says direct submission is appropriate.

External MCP spend rule: this tool costs ChatCut credits and starts an async generation job. Only call it when the user's request or confirmation clearly covers this exact generation; do not silently create extra variants, longer durations, higher quality, or additional outputs.

emotion.description: Doubao only. Provider emotion label such as happy, sad, angry, surprised, tender, storytelling, or ASMR. Only use voices whose guide says emotion is supported.

emotionScale.description: Doubao only. 1–5 emotion intensity; requires emotion. Official scale is nonlinear and support/ranges vary by voice.

explicitDialect.description: Doubao only. Explicit dialect control; currently only supported by the Vivi preset/raw voice.

loudnessRatio.description: Doubao only. 0.5–2.0, default 1.0. Mapped to Doubao loudness_rate percentage delta.

modelId.description: ElevenLabs only. Defaults to "eleven_multilingual_v2". Ignored for doubao.

performancePrompt.description: Doubao only. Natural-language voice direction for voices with instruction support, e.g. '语速稍慢，痛心但克制' or '欢乐一点，像朋友介绍'.

pitch.description: Doubao only. Post-process pitch shift in semitones, -12–12.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

provider.description: TTS engine. Use fish-audio only with a ChatCut customVoiceId returned by manage_voice.

speedRatio.description: Doubao only. 0.5–2.0, default 1.0. Mapped to Doubao's percentage delta server-side.

stability.description: ElevenLabs only. 0–1, default 0.5. Lower = more expressive, higher = more consistent.

text.description: Text to synthesize for this TTS generation job.

voiceId.description: Provider-specific voice id. For fish-audio, pass the ChatCut customVoiceId from manage_voice, never a Fish model id. For official voices, pass voiceId returned by manage_voice action=list.
